sents.zh: 很久以前，人们买东西用的是金子做的钱。
sents.en: Long ago people bought things with money made of gold.

sents.zh: 这样的钱很小，可是很重。
sents.en: That money was small, but heavy.

sents.zh: 如果只买一点东西，那还可以。
sents.en: If you were buying only a little, it was fine.

sents.zh: 可是商人一次要买很多。
sents.en: But a merchant bought a great deal at once.

sents.zh: 所以他们要带很多很多钱。
sents.en: So they had to carry a great deal of money.

sents.zh: 钱太重了，一个人拿不动。
sents.en: It was too heavy for one person to carry.

sents.zh: 有的人还觉得路上不安全。
sents.en: Some also felt the road was not safe.

sents.zh: 宋朝的人想到了一个办法。
sents.en: Song people thought of a way.

sents.zh: 他们把钱放在一个地方，然后拿一张纸。
sents.en: They left the money in one place and took a piece of paper.
On the paper was written how much it stood for.

sents.zh: 因为纸又轻又小，所以带着很方便。
sents.en: Because paper is light and small, it was easy to carry.

sents.zh: 到了别的城，用这张纸就可以拿到钱。
sents.en: In another city, that paper could be exchanged for the money.

sents.zh: 这样，商人可以走得更远。
城里的买卖也越来越多了。
sents.en: Trade in the cities grew and grew.

sents.zh: 今天世界上很多国家用的还是纸做的钱。
sents.en: Today many countries still use money made of paper.
